# SalesMail Bidirectional Integrations

## **SalesMail Integrations**

SalesMail connects seamlessly with CRM platforms to help you streamline workflows, reduce manual entry, and keep your teams aligned.

### **Current Bidirectional CRM Integrations**

SalesMail currently offers **two-way (bidirectional) integrations** with the following platforms:

- **[Aline Enquire](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/how-to-send-video-messages-using-salesmail-with-an-enquire-integration)**

- **[Aline Sherpa](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/how-to-send-a-video-message-using-salesmail-with-sherpa-integration)**

- **[WelcomeHome](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/welcomehome-integration-help)**


These integrations allow data to flow both ways, helping ensure your teams always have up-to-date information while maintaining a smooth, connected experience.

* * *

### **Request Integration Setup on your Account**

If you have one of the above CRMs and need integration set up on your account, please reach out to your Client Success Specialist or email us at [support@salesmail.com](mailto:support@salesmail.com) .

### **Request a New Integration**

Don’t see the platform you’re looking for?

We’re always evaluating new integrations based on customer demand and strategic fit.

👉

**[Request a new integration](mailto:product.management@salesmail.com?subject=SalesMail%20Integration%20Request)**

Our team will review your request and follow up if additional details are needed.
